workload: all original selftest defaults; case v2, 500ms / 100000 / 8-16-8 unchanged

profiles.host: caffeinate -i; Docker VM temporarily reduced 10->4 vCPUs to leave host scheduling headroom; original settings restored after all attempts

run_policy: two diagnostic full runs per profile, serial in A/B/C order, all saved regardless of result; no other test/build activity concurrently
instrumentation: in-memory >1ms spans, guest CPU IDs, native macOS all-vCPU accounting every requested 1ms, paired 80-roundtrip clock brackets, filtered sched_switch/wakeup own trace instance with 16MiB per CPU ring; no skb event stream
qualification_policy: exactly once each after C diagnostics, without trace/host sampler/hot-path wrappers; same CPU policy. Full must pass 20ms plus all functional checks; cancellation and overflow must be oracle negatives with their tightened independent checks passing. Both C diagnostics must also meet oracle timing before claiming environment qualified. No best-of selection.
formal_policy: only after every qualification prerequisite passes, frozen worker + lease + maintainer process; otherwise NOT_RUN and known-BLOCKED retained
limitations: guest CPU pinning is not physical host affinity or exclusive CPU ownership; C alters two environment factors relative to B (VM CPU count and necessary guest affinity remap), so their effects cannot be separated by this design
